description.en: Four skills for web decks, social cards, page layout and De-AI editing, built on one design system. The gallery holds official examples and your own work, so the next piece in the same style is one click away.
description.zh: 网页 PPT、图文卡片、网页排版、去 AI 味四个 skill，共用一套设计系统；展示库收着官方示例和你做过的作品，一键做同风格的下一份。
